slides.title: Dates, Spices and Sweets
slides.text: Dates are a gift of the desert in both countries. Tunisia is famous for Deglet Nour dates from the oases of Tozeur and Kebili, and Bahrain for the Khalas and Khunaizi varieties of its palm groves. Both kitchens turn dates into dessert: Tunisian makroudh is a semolina pastry stuffed with dates and soaked in honey, and Bahraini luqaimat are golden dough balls dipped in date syrup.
